data.name: Description
data.value: A command to a security device asks for a click on this computer: the voice is not enough. Jarvis finds the devices a command aims at before it decides.

data.name: Always
data.value: Locks, alarms, valves, sirens, and covers that are a garage door, a door or a gate.

data.name: EntitiesHint
data.value: One name per line, as Home Assistant names the device.

data.name: ScriptsHint
data.value: A script can actuate anything, and its name does not say what. Without a mark, a script runs without a question.

data.name: NoScript
data.value: No connected server offers a script.

data.name: ContextHint
data.value: Each command reads the devices Home Assistant exposes. The list is reused for this long, from 0 to {0} seconds.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The settings file cannot be written.
